BEFORE YOU BEGIN

A few things you might be wondering.

About building client portals with Atomic.

Can each client see only their own projects?

That is an access rule to include in your brief and verify in the finished app. Atomic’s backend supports identity and permissions, but a role preview alone is not proof of isolation. Test with separate accounts and records before inviting clients.

Can the team and clients have different views?

Yes. Describe the screens and actions for each role. Atomic supports screen and role previews so you can try the workflow as different people while you build.

Do I need a paid plan for client accounts?

The proposed Free plan includes the backend, database, and authentication a portal needs for one app; Builder and Pro include them for every app, along with collaboration.

Can I keep the generated code?

Yes. You can browse and download the generated source. A source download does not include client accounts, business records, or hosting. Plan any data migration separately.
